title: HIP host infrastructure (stream pool, allocator, multi-arch dispatch)
description:
## Goal

Stand up the HIP host infrastructure per Phase 0 design doc §6: HIP
stream pool, allocator wrappers, deterministic-launch helpers, and
multi-arch dispatch shim. gfx1030 is the only CI target today; gfx1100
/ gfx1200 / MI series seams documented but unexercised.

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages) within epic `gf2-sim`
(`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §6 (multi-arch HIP dispatch),
§5 (crate boundaries). Wave B.1: must complete before Wave B.2
(`f6004add`, `a930be7f`, `d3f1616a`) starts.

Existing `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/src/lib.rs` (HIP kernel FFI surface)
and `src/ffi.rs` (hip_malloc / hip_memcpy / launch_* externs) are the
foundation. This task adds host-side dispatcher machinery that all
Phase B kernel stages call into.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/src/host/streams.rs`:
   - `pub struct HipStream` (RAII wrapper around `hipStream_t`).
   - `pub struct HipStreamPool { streams: Vec<HipStream> }` with
     round-robin / oldest-idle acquisition.
   - `HipStreamPool::new(device_id: i32, n: usize) -> Result<Self,
     HipError>`.
2. `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/src/host/alloc.rs`:
   - `pub struct DeviceBuffer<T>` (RAII wrapper around `hip_malloc /
     hip_free`).
   - `pub struct PinnedHostBuffer<T>` for staged H2D / D2H.
   - `DeviceBuffer::new_with_fallback(...)` returns
     `Result<Self, RecoverableError::OutOfMemory>` so the executor
     can catch + substitute (design-doc §8).
3. `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/src/host/launch.rs`:
   - Helper macros / functions for deterministic kernel launches:
     fixed grid + block dimensions, no atomic reductions on f32, no
     unspecified-order dispatch.
4. `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/src/host/arch.rs`:
   - `pub enum GfxTarget { Gfx1030, Gfx1100, Gfx1200, Gfx90a,
     Gfx940, Gfx942 }`.
   - `GfxTarget::detect() -> Result<Self, HipError>` invoking
     `hipDeviceGetAttribute(major, minor)`.
   - Per-arch kernel blob loading from
     `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/kernels/<target>/*.co` produced by
     `build.rs`.
5. `crates/gf2-kernels-hip/build.rs`:
   - Compiles HIP kernels with `hipcc --offload-arch=<target>` once
     per target.
   - gfx1030 must compile successfully or the build fails; other
     archs are best-effort (skip if toolchain unavailable).
6. `crates/gf2-sim/src/gpu/mod.rs` (visible only with feature `hip`):
   - `pub struct HipDispatcher` owning a `HipStreamPool` + per-stage
     scratch.
   - Used by Phase B kernel stages and the Phase C executor.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `cargo build --workspace --features hip --release` builds
  clean on the gfx1030 CI host.
- [hard] `cargo build --workspace --release` (no `--features hip`)
  builds clean on non-ROCm hosts (HIP crate excluded from default
  members).
- [hard] Runtime arch detection on gfx1030 returns
  `GfxTarget::Gfx1030`; on an unsupported arch emits a
  `tracing::warn!` and falls back per design-doc §6.
- [hard] OOM path: a forced `DeviceBuffer::new` with
  `bytes > device_memory` returns
  `RecoverableError::OutOfMemory{ device_id, bytes_requested }`,
  not a panic.
- [hard] CLAUDE.md updated with the multi-arch target list and the
  HIP dispatcher model (lands as part of Phase B close via
  `14f59c2d`).
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- No kernel implementations (owned by `f6004add`, `a930be7f`,
  `d3f1616a`).
- No multi-GPU implementation (epic non-goal; seams only).
- No NVIDIA / CUDA backend (epic non-goal).
